mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 77 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park, with a Waxing Gibbous moon rising tonight.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee construction and utility projects, with a deadline of September 20. Also, remember that the Council recently approved new sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today and live music at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event for local youth.
On Friday, Verona police arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after officers found her unresponsive behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake, and Culver's is open until 10:30 PM. You can also catch Kona Ice at Fireman's Park until 5 PM or at the high school stadium until 7:30 PM today.
